basics.name: Shubhank Saxena
basics.label: Software Engineer, Backend & Infrastructure
basics.summary: I'm a backend and infrastructure engineer. Most of my work lives in the layer that keeps products running: rewriting services for scale, standing up observability, and shipping zero-downtime migrations and deploys. I currently lead technology at First Round's On Me, an early-stage social-app startup, where I took the backend from a business pivot to production in two months. Running alongside that is a longer thread I care about: assistive technology. I hold three patents and have built tools for people who are blind or navigating autism, turning hard accessibility problems into software that ships.
